title: Second-Retry Log Row — Corpus-530 Next Wave (minLength/pattern empty-string)
description: Schema for one second-retry row under next-wave/measurements/second_retry/logs/. Fires only when first retry failed with ValidationFailed minLength/pattern and got == '""' (empty string). Enriched prompt = field+constraint+message+similar valid example without exposing full schema.

model.description: openai/gpt-4o-mini or open model via openrouter

parent_id.description: id of the first-retry recovery case, e.g. R01, R05, R10

field.description: dotted field path of failing field, e.g. query, evidence_items.0.content, rationale

got.description: json.dumps of failing corrected value, e.g. '""'

first_retry_error.description: ValidationFailed typed error from first retry (field+constraint+got+message+boundary)

example_valid_value.description: similar valid example drawn from corpus (not schema), e.g. 'hello', 'evidence text from experiment', 'This rationale has enough length...'

example_source.description: where example came from, e.g. malformed-recovery.json#R01 corrected_args query or tasks.json#C3-T10

second_retry_prompt_text.description: enriched prompt text: 3 sentences max, field+constraint+message+example without full schema
